headline: What Happens Right After a Car Accident in San Diego?

publisher.name: Law Office of Angelo J. Reyes, APC

articleBody: Getting into a car accident is scary, and it's totally normal to feel rattled. But knowing what to do in those immediate moments can really make a difference for any potential personal injury claim later on. First things first, check on everyone's safety. If anyone's injured, call 911 right away for emergency medical help. Even if you feel okay, it's a good idea to get checked out by paramedics or a doctor as soon as possible, as some injuries aren't immediately obvious. Next, if possible and safe, move your vehicle to the side of the road to prevent further accidents. You'll also want to exchange information with the other driver – get their name, contact details, insurance information, and license plate number. Don't admit fault or apologize, even if you feel like you might have contributed; emotions run high and you don't have all the facts yet. It’s important to collect as much evidence as you can. Use your phone to take photos of the accident scene from different angles, including vehicle damage, road conditions, traffic signs, and any visible injuries. If there were witnesses, ask for their contact information too. Once you're safely away from the scene, report the accident to your insurance company. This is a critical step, but be careful what you say, as it could impact your claim. An experienced personal injury attorney, like Angelo J. Reyes, can help guide you through these initial steps, ensuring your rights are protected and you don't inadvertently harm your future claim. They can also help you understand your options for property damage recovery and compensation for your injuries.
